results.title: The Measurement of Innovation: A Systematic Review and Bibliometric Analysis of Global Innovation Index Research
results.content: Beyond Books: Student Perspectives on Emerging Technologies, Usability, and Ethics in the Library of the Future. Editor’s Choice articles are based on recommendations by the scientific editors of MDPI journals from around the world. Editors select a small number of articles recently published in the journal that they believe will be particularly interesting to readers, or important in the respective research area. The aim is to provide a snapshot of some of the most exciting work published in the various research areas of the journal. The purpose of this review is to synthesise the accumulated knowledge on Global Innovation Index (GII) research. The findings from the bibliographic coupling revealed five recent lines of investigation in GII research: configurational methods; innovation efficiency and policy; competitiveness, entrepreneurship, and sustainable development; innovation rankings; and culture. We aim to enhance the field of Innovation Studies by showcasing the current state of research on the GII, one of the most promising tools for measuring innovation activity, and to provide insights into potential future research avenues to further develop this area of study.
